The shortcode has to sit on a line of its own, with a blank line before and after.

A whole section, by the identifier of its heading:

```markdown
{{{< external examples/snippet.qmd#first >}}}
```

{{< external examples/snippet.qmd#first >}}

A div, by its identifier, with the headings shifted so they sit under this one:

```markdown
{{{< external examples/snippet.qmd#second shift=3 >}}}
```

{{< external examples/snippet.qmd#second shift=3 >}}

A slice of the raw file, by line number:

```markdown
{{{< external examples/snippet.qmd#L7 >}}}
```

{{< external examples/snippet.qmd#L7 >}}

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-external/>.
